How do the formulations compare?

MethodRaw AUC@5Returned AUC@5Guard

D: odometry + pose graph (Open3D), or joint odometry (bae). E: fixed-structure photometric refinement. D+E chains the raw stages before the common guard.

Inputs, rendering and reproducibility

Raw proposals are reported even when rejected. A photometric guard is not a guarantee of better ground-truth pose accuracy. Surface fusion and filtering use the same settings before and after; no generated imagery or retouching is used.
